lessons.culture: In Cairo, one of the first things people ask a new acquaintance is 'بتشتغل إيه؟', because a person's work says a lot about who they are. Asking about salary straight away is rude except between very close friends.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، أيوه شُفته، فيه اجتماع الساعة عشرة.
dialogue.transliteration: sabaa7 en-noor, aywa shufto, fi egtimaa3 es-saa3a 3ashara.
dialogue.english: Good morning, yes I saw it, there's a meeting at ten.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: يا نهار أبيض! وأنا لسه ماخلّصتش التقرير.
dialogue.transliteration: ya nahaar abyaD! w ana lessa makhallastesh el ta2reer.
dialogue.english: Oh no! And I still haven't finished the report.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: خلّصه بسرعة، المدير بيطلب حاجات كتير أوي الأيام دي.
dialogue.transliteration: khallaso bsor3a, el mudiir biyoTlob 7agaat kiteer awi el ayyaam di.
dialogue.english: Finish it quickly, the manager is very demanding these days.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: عارف عارف، بس الطابعة بتبوظ كل شوية ومش عارف أطبعه.
dialogue.transliteration: 3aaref 3aaref, bas eT-Taab3a betbawwaz kol shwayya w mesh 3aaref aTba3o.
dialogue.english: I know I know, but the printer keeps breaking and I can't print it.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: خد اطبعه على الطابعة اللي في مكتبي.
dialogue.transliteration: khod otba3o 3ala eT-Taab3a elli fi maktabi.
dialogue.english: Take it and print it on the printer in my office.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: الله يخلّيكي، كويس إن عندي زميلة زيّك.
dialogue.transliteration: allaah yekhalliiki, kwayyis inn 3andi zameela zayyik.
dialogue.english: God keep you, it's good I have a colleague like you.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: ولا يهمّك، بس ماتنساش الاجتماع.
dialogue.transliteration: wala yehimmak, bas matensash el egtimaa3.
dialogue.english: Don't mention it, but don't forget the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: ماتقلقيش، هبقى جاهز.
dialogue.transliteration: mat2al2ish, hab2a gaahez.
dialogue.english: Don't worry, I'll be ready.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: تمام، وبعد الاجتماع فيه غدا مع الفريق.
dialogue.transliteration: tamaam, w ba3d el egtimaa3 fi ghada ma3 el fareeq.
dialogue.english: Good, and after the meeting there's lunch with the team.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: تسلمي، أنا هقوم أخلّص الشغلانة دي بقى.
dialogue.transliteration: teslami, ana ha2oom akhallas el shaghlaana di ba2a.

In his office, talking on the phone.

pair.english: Do you want to work overtime today?

response.english: No thanks, I want to go home early.

lessons.culture: Most Cairo offices start around nine and finish around five, with a lunch break in the middle. Colleagues use first names, but add 'أستاذ' or 'دكتور' plus the name for a manager or an older person; 'يا باشمهندس' is also common for engineers.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: إزيّك يا نور، رايحة فين؟

dialogue.transliteration: raay7a el maktaba, 3andi imti7aan bukra w laazim azaakir.
dialogue.english: Going to the library, I have an exam tomorrow and I have to study.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: امتحان إيه؟

dialogue.english: Which exam?

dialogue.arabic: كيمياء، مافهمتش المحاضرة الأخيرة كويس.
dialogue.transliteration: keemya, mafhemtesh el mo7aaDra el akheera kwayyis.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: وأنا كمان عندي المادة دي، الدكتور بيتكلّم بسرعة أوي.
dialogue.transliteration: w ana kamaan 3andi el maadda di, ed-doktoor biyitkallim bsor3a awi.
dialogue.english: I have that subject too, the professor talks very fast.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: فعلاً، تعرف تشرحلي جزء التفاعلات؟
dialogue.transliteration: fe3lan, ti3raf teshra7li guz2 el tafaa3olaat?
dialogue.english: Really, can you explain the reactions part to me?

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: طبعاً، تعالي نقعد سوا في المكتبة ونحلّ الأسئلة.
dialogue.transliteration: Tab3an, ta3aali n2o3od sawa fil maktaba w ne7ill el as2ila.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: تسلم، بس لازم أسلّم أسايمنت كمان قبل الجمعة.
dialogue.transliteration: teslam, bas laazim asallim asaymint kamaan abl el gum3a.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: ماشي، يلا بينا.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: يلا، بس الأول نشرب قهوة.
dialogue.transliteration: yalla, bas el awwel nishrab ahwa.
dialogue.english: Let's go, but first let's drink coffee.

lessons.culture: At Cairo University and other Egyptian universities, students call teachers 'دكتور' or 'دكتورة' whatever their age, and 'يا باشمهندس' is what engineering students call each other. Libraries fill up before exams, and many students study together in groups.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: عمر، ناوي تعمل إيه بعد ما تتخرّج؟
dialogue.transliteration: 3omar, nawi ta3mel eh ba3d ma tetkharrag?
dialogue.english: Omar, what do you plan to do after you graduate?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: بصراحة لسه ماقرّرتش، بس بفكّر أكمّل ماجستير.
dialogue.transliteration: beSaraa7a lessa ma2arrartesh, bas bafakkar akammil magistir.
dialogue.english: Honestly I haven't decided yet, but I'm thinking of continuing to a master's.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: في أنهي مجال؟

dialogue.transliteration: fil handasa, w ba3dein bafakkar asaafir ashtaghal barra shwayya.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: يا سلام، وهتسافر لوحدك يعني؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya salaam, w hatsaafir liwa7dak ya3ni?
dialogue.english: Wow, and you'll travel on your own, you mean?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أيوه، بس بعد كام سنة هرجع وأفتح مشروع خاص بيا هنا.
dialogue.transliteration: aywa, bas ba3d kam sana harga3 w afta7 mashroo3 khaaS beya hena.
dialogue.english: Yes, but after a few years I'll come back and open my own project here.

dialogue.arabic: حلم حلو، وأنا طموحي أبقى مديرة في يوم من الأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ilm 7ilw, w ana Tomoo7i ab2a mudeera fi yom mel ayyaam.
dialogue.english: A nice dream, and my ambition is to become a manager one day.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أكيد هتوصلي، إنتي شاطرة أوي في شغلك.
dialogue.transliteration: akeed hatewsali, enti shaaTra awi fi shoghlik.
dialogue.english: You'll definitely get there, you're very good at your work.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، المهم أكون مرتاحة في شغلي.
dialogue.transliteration: in sha2 allaah, el muhemm akoon murtaa7a fi shoghli.
dialogue.english: God willing, the important thing is that I'm comfortable in my work.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: صح، الفلوس مهمة بس مش كل حاجة.
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7, el floos muhimma bas mesh kol 7aaga.
dialogue.english: True, money is important but not everything.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: ربنا يوفّقك في مشروعك، وأنا في الترقية.
dialogue.transliteration: rabbena yewaffa2ak fi mashroo3ak, w ana fil tar2iyya.
dialogue.english: May God grant you success in your project, and me in my promotion.

response.arabic: عايز أدوّر على شغل في مجالي.
response.english: I want to look for a job in my field.

pair.english: Are you thinking of travelling to work abroad?

response.arabic: أيوه، بفكّر في الموضوع شوية شوية.
response.transliteration: aywa, bafakkar fil mawDoo3 shwayya shwayya.
response.english: Yes, I'm thinking about it little by little.
My dream is to open a restaurant.

pair.english: Where will you be in five years?

response.arabic: إن شاء الله أبقى مستقر في شغل كويس.
response.transliteration: in sha2 allaah ab2a mustaqirr fi shoghl kwayyis.
response.english: God willing I'll be settled in a good job.

lessons.culture: When Egyptians talk about the future they add 'إن شاء الله' after almost every plan, even a sure one, because the future is in God's hands. Opening a small project or a restaurant is a very common dream in Cairo as a way to be independent, and a government job is still seen as the safe choice.

challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Egyptian Arabic conversation of at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using بتشتغل إيه or بتشتغلي إيه.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using فين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنة or سنين.
A future plan using هـ or عايز or ناوي.
A mention of an ambition or dream using طموحي or حلمي.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as ربنا يوفّقك or ولا يهمّك.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: مايا، بتشتغلي إيه دلوقتي؟
dialogue.transliteration: maya, beteshtaghali eh dilwa2ti?
dialogue.english: Maya, what do you do now?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: باشتغل محامية في مكتب صغير، وإنت؟
dialogue.transliteration: bashtaghal mo7aamiyya fi maktab Soghayyar, w enta?
dialogue.english: I work as a lawyer at a small office, and you?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: أنا لسه بدرس اقتصاد في الجامعة، في رابعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ana lessa badris eqtiSaad fil gam3a, fi raab3a.
dialogue.english: I'm still studying economics at university, in the fourth year.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، وبعد ما تتخرّج ناوي تعمل إيه؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma sha2 allaah, w ba3d ma tetkharrag nawi ta3mel eh?
dialogue.english: Wonderful, and after you graduate what do you plan to do?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: هقدّم على وظيفة في بنك، إن شاء الله ألاقي حاجة كويسة.
dialogue.transliteration: ha2addim 3ala waZeefa fi bank, in sha2 allaah alaa2i 7aaga kwayyisa.
dialogue.english: I'll apply for a job at a bank, God willing I'll find something good.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، وطموحك إيه في المستقبل؟
dialogue.transliteration: in sha2 allaah, w Tomoo7ak eh fil mustaqbal?
dialogue.english: God willing, and what's your ambition for the future?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: طموحي أبقى مدير فرع في يوم من الأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: Tomoo7i ab2a mudiir far3 fi yom mel ayyaam.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a branch manager one day.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: حلو أوي، وأنا كمان عايزة أكمّل الماجستير في القانون.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ilw awi, w ana kamaan 3aayza akammil el magistir fil qaanoon.
dialogue.english: Very nice, and I also want to continue to a master's in law.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: ربنا يوفّقك، أكيد هتوصلي.
dialogue.transliteration: rabbena yewaffa2ek, akeed hatewsali.
dialogue.english: May God grant you success, you'll definitely get there.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: تسلم، وأتمنّى توصل لهدفك إنت كمان.
dialogue.transliteration: teslam, w atmanna tewSal li-hadafak enta kamaan.
dialogue.english: Thank you, and I hope you reach your goal too.
